dessin: A cropped excerpt of a printed topographic map seen from above, filling the ENTIRE image edge to edge: the pale paper color #FBFCF8 covers the whole image, no outer background color, no frame, no border, no outline around the image, no margin; the drawing is cut cleanly by the four image edges as if the map continued beyond them. Buildings only: about twelve small building footprints drawn as solid ink #23281F filled rectangles and L-shapes of different sizes, aligned along two implied perpendicular streets left as empty pale bands; no outlines around the streets, no trees, no water, no contour lines. No text, no letters, no numbers, no contour labels, no symbols other than those described, nothing else.
